name: Las Vegas
intro: Las Vegas had no MICHELIN Guide from 2009 until August 2026, when the first MICHELIN Guide Southwest (Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico and Utah) brought stars back to the Strip. All of them are in casino resorts: Joël Robuchon’s two restaurants at MGM Grand, Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace and é by José Andrés at The Cosmopolitan. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add), checked October 2026.
